2026-08-20.patch_summary: This patch addresses the issue of stale memory cgroup (memcg) stats causing premature OOM kills by proposing a solution to reduce the overhead of updating and flushing these statistics. The idea is for memcg to accumulate updates on a per-CPU basis, then propagate them up to a global atomic counter when it reaches a certain threshold, eliminating the need for frequent flushing. This approach aims to scale better for large machines with many cores and focuses on reducing the number of stats that require flushing, specifically NR_FILE_DIRTY and NR_WRITEBACK in the writeback case.
